## Change class

- [ ] Product / implementation
- [ ] Documentation / governance
- [ ] Evidence-carrying research PR
- [ ] Formal kernel / theorem PR
- [ ] Financial / external-execution artifact

## Summary

What changes, and why?

## Lineage / authority

For evidence-carrying work, complete the applicable fields:

- Stable ID:
- Primary parent:
- Side parents:
- Frozen source/protocol SHA-256:
- Runtime/toolchain:
- Official invocation count:
- Same-ID rerun count:
- First terminal:
- Receipt/artifact digest:
- Evidence carrier or integration candidate:

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks run
- [ ] Frozen digest verified before official execution (if applicable)
- [ ] First terminal preserved
- [ ] No post-result metric/definition repair
- [ ] Failure/error/timeout repaired only through a new additive successor ID
- [ ] Receipts/artifacts preserved where available

## Claim ceiling

State explicitly what this PR **does not** establish.

Examples: empirical truth, threat-model completeness, independent reproduction, production superiority, external authority, biological claims, open-problem closure, economic realization, IP valuation.

## Execution / financial authority

- [ ] No purchase, trading, capital, deployment, or external-action authority is implied by this PR
- [ ] Any required present-tense authorization is separate and explicit

## Merge rule

- [ ] This PR may be considered for integration after review
- [ ] **Evidence carrier only — keep draft/unmerged unless a later explicit integration decision is made**

> Governance invariant: preserve the first terminal. No same-ID interpretive rescue. Repairs are additive successors, not rewritten history.
